articles.title: Fatality at Palito Complex
articles.summary: GlobeNewswire: Fatality at Palito Complex. Fatality at Palito Complex Serabi Gold plc (“Serabi” or the “Company”) (AIM:SRB, TSX:SBI, OTCQX:SRBIF), the Brazilian focused gold mining and development company, regrets to announce an incident occurred resulting in a fatality at its Palito underground operation on 30 January 2026. The incident was related to a traffic accident underground at the Palito Complex. No other personnel were injured. International Health Dialogue (IHD) 2026 opened today in Hyderabad, bringing together clinicians, patient safety leaders, accreditation experts, and health system policymakers from India and abroad. With the theme Global Voices. One Vision. Day 1 centred patient safety where it truly belongs, as a leadership and governance priority, shaped by equity and enabled by responsible digital transformation.
